in_sanskrit.name: मितेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Mitesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mitra', which means friend. The name Mitesh is thus a tribute to the deity Mitra, who is revered as the god of friendship, alliances, and contracts in Hinduism.

in_hindi.name: मितेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: Mitesh के नाम संस्कृत साझाई 'मित्र' से उत्पन्न हुआ है जिसका अर्थ दोस्त है। इस नाम के लिए 'मित्रेश्वर' के रूप में मित्रा देवता पूजित रहता है।

in_tamil.name: மிதேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Mitesh in Tamil translates to 'one who resides in the absence of friendship'. This name is believed to bring good fortune and strengthen existing relationships.

in_telugu.name: మిటేశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Mitesh in Telugu is 'Mitra-doshapeshadaresh', meaning the lord of Mitra's curse. This name is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.

in_marathi.name: Mitesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Friend of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mitesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mitesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Mitra', which means friend. The suffix 'esh' denotes the presence of a deity or God. Therefore, Mitesh can be translated as 'Friend of God'.
